features: Two network interfaces: cameras 1-16 connect through the plug & play PoE ports, cameras 17-32 through a switch on a closed network
AccuSearch: one-click targeted search by matching appearance details across recordings
Facial recognition on up to 6 channels, or 3 channels with AccuSearch enabled; 32 libraries, 10,000 face pictures; 18 pictures/second
Face detection: 32 channels (AI by IPC); AI by device: 2 channels at 2MP or 1 channel at 4MP (1 channel with AccuSearch enabled)
Human/vehicle classification: 32 channels (AI by IPC); human/vehicle attribute analysis (AI by IPC)
Fisheye dewarping via NVR, web client and mobile app
eSATA drive up to 26 TB, for recording only
notes: When IPC AI functions are enabled, actual incoming bandwidth exceeds the value set in the NVR.
